preconditions: Source and shared privacy CI pass
Exact static native-byte and relative-path parity passes
Preserve original source commit and verified snapshot for rollback
cutover_order: Verify the immutable rollback snapshot, create its approved preservation branch at the recorded original commit and retain the current deployment
With explicit approval, switch Pages build type to workflow without changing the repository URL
Merge the reviewed source migration head
Dispatch the manual workflow on main with the exact manifest SHA-256
Verify the unchanged public URL and representative HTML/JSON/model/download routes
If needed, restore legacy Pages from the verified preservation branch root or redeploy the verified snapshot artifact; preserve the source-only main branch

rollback.method: Before cutover, create the preservation branch at this exact original commit; if rollback is needed, restore legacy Pages to this branch root without resetting main or rewriting history.
